summary: Plan completed and committed (cbd2b49): cross-cutting shape; P1 adds architectureProducer and amends the guide in JenkinsPipelineUtils, P2-P4 migrate the 78 producers (50 deploy and 25 app producers become one call, Ansible/DockerImages/IoTSupport become full declarative files) as local commits listed in a producer ledger for the test phase's one-go push, and P5 updates the review records; verification.json has 15 criteria, with V14 (KubeCoderDeploy's producer reaching prd) owed until the next KubeCoder promotion. Three doc and template items outside the plan's scope went to the close-out report (P1, P2, B1).
